entry.title: New: Resolution 724 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO HO‘OMALU KA‘Ū

Approves a grant of $25,500 to Ho‘omalu Ka‘ū, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to support ongoing efforts to manage and maintain land for traditional cultural uses and practices at the Kahua ‘Olohū, Ka‘ū, property (Tax Map Key: 9-5-012:005), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.
